title: Expires must not be in the past

spec.name: RFC 9116
spec.normative_quote: The "Expires" field indicates the date and time after which the data contained in the "security.txt" file is considered stale and should not be used. Consumers of a security.txt file whose Expires date has passed SHOULD consider its contents stale.
spec.note: Recalled from training-data familiarity with the published RFC, not re-verified against a live fetch this session (this agent has no WebFetch access). The deferred drift probe (ADR 0011 follow-up (h)) must reconcile this quote against a live re-fetch of spec.url before it is treated as verified.

applicability: A security.txt body containing a parseable Expires: value.
expectation: The parsed Expires instant is not earlier than the evaluation instant.

cases.name: Expires in the future -- this rule does not fire
